選擇出發地，才能找附近可搭的站牌。: Choose a start to find nearby bus stops.
路線資料載入後即可規劃。: Routes will be available after loading.

先確認實際步行，再比較可趕上的班次、候車與搭車時間。推薦兼顧時間、少走路與少轉乘: We check walking connections before comparing buses you can catch, waiting and riding time. Recommendations balance time, walking and transfers. Faster alternatives are kept when useful. Estimated service intervals show a range; missing service remains unconfirmed. Arrival includes walking, waiting and riding.
可使用定位，或輸入出發地／站名: Use your location, or enter a place or stop
候車以官方下一班到站時間為主。官方未指定車牌；各車紀錄足夠才顯示分鐘數，否則先看: Use the official next-bus time while waiting. The source does not identify its vehicle. Individual times appear only with enough evidence. The map smoothly replays received positions with a short buffer. See Arriving buses for details.

請先在搭車畫面選擇車牌: Choose your bus plate on the trip screen
暫無車輛位置，稍後再選擇: Positions are unavailable. Try again shortly.

含估計候車時間，班次更新後會調整: Includes estimated waiting; updates with service data
步行時間較長，這班可能趕不上。: You may not reach the stop before this bus.

軌跡可確認時排除已通過車輛；沿線距離依 GPS 推估。官方時間未綁定車牌。: Passed buses are excluded when the route is confirmed. Official times do not identify a bus plate.

依目前 GPS 與路線順序推估，不是車輛到站時間。: Official next-bus times at these stops; not a prediction for this plate.
臺北市公共運輸處公開資料，每 15 秒重新取得。個別公車回報時間以車輛卡片為準。: Taipei’s public bus data is checked every 5 seconds while active. Individual reporting times vary.
官方到站預估沒有車牌資訊；請以站牌的路線預估為準。: Official arrival times identify a route and stop, not a plate. Use the stop’s official next-bus time.
回到 App 時立即更新；背景暫停畫面與輪詢。官方車輛資料會持續產生。: Data refreshes when you return. Updates pause in the background.
選車時淡化建築: Fade buildings when following a bus
原生 MapLibre / Metal 地圖，使用 OpenFreeMap 底圖: MapLibre / Metal with OpenFreeMap; terrain relief is pre-rendered from AWS Terrain Tiles and built into the app. Road alignment depends on GPS and route accuracy.
定位只在使用期間尋找附近站牌，可直接手動搜尋；位置不會傳到公車資料來源。: Location is optional and used only while the app is active. You can search manually. Coordinates are not sent to the bus data provider.
定位為選用，只在使用 App 時尋找附近站牌、規劃行程與定位地圖。也能拒絕定位，: Location is optional and used while the app is active to find stops, plan trips and center the map. You can decline and choose a start, stop or route manually. Bus data requests do not include your coordinates.
地點搜尋與步行路線由 Apple 地圖提供；搜尋文字及路線起終點由 Apple: Apple Maps provides place search and walking directions, and processes search text and route endpoints.
地圖供應者會收到目前畫面需要的圖磚請求及網路連線資訊，因此可能得知你正在查看的大: The map provider receives tile requests and connection information, which may reveal the general area you are viewing.
搜尋別名、文字、外觀及既有搭車設定會從 GitHub 下載。這個請求不包含定位或: Search aliases, text, appearance and existing travel settings are downloaded from GitHub. Requests do not include location or search text; GitHub receives standard connection information.
收藏站牌、最近目的地、最近查看與地圖偏好保存在此裝置。App 沒有帳號、廣告或跨: Favorites, recent destinations, recent views, map and language preferences stay on this device. There are no accounts, ads, cross-app tracking or analytics SDKs.
公車資料來自臺北市公開資料服務；底圖由 OpenFreeMap 提供。服務商可能: Bus data comes from Taipei’s public data service; OpenFreeMap provides the map. Providers may process connection logs under their own policies.
透過 TestFlight 主動回報時，Apple 與開發者可能收到你提交的內容: When you submit TestFlight feedback, Apple and the developer may receive your message, screenshots and diagnostics. Check screenshots for location information before sharing.
可在 iPhone 系統設定關閉定位。刪除 App 可移除其本機收藏與偏好。: Turn off location in iPhone settings. Deleting the app removes its local favorites and preferences.
找不到相符地點，試試地址或站牌: No matching place. Try an address or stop.
搜尋暫時無法連線，可改選站牌，或稍後重試。: Search is unavailable. Choose a stop or try again shortly.

目前無定位資料，官方時間仍可查看: Positions unavailable; official times are available

底圖無法載入，請檢查網路後重試: Unable to load the map. Check your connection and retry.
時間依行駛情況更新，塞車與停靠可能影響預估。: Times update with the bus. Traffic and stops can affect estimates.
依近期車輛通過各站的時間估算: Based on recent bus travel between stops
依這輛車近期的行駛情況估算: Based on this bus’s recent movement
候車請以官方下一班為準。: Use the official next-bus time while waiting.

官方目前標示「%@」，候車以官方資訊為準。: Official status: %@. Use official information while waiting.

定位來源連線中斷，保留最後回報: Position connection interrupted · last report retained

行駛紀錄較少或變化較大，先顯示站數，等待時間確認。: Movement data is limited or variable. Stop progress is shown until time is confirmed.
行駛紀錄較少，時間僅供參考: Limited movement data; time is approximate
車輛位置尚未確認，暫停推估到站時間。: The bus position is unconfirmed; arrival estimates are paused.
車輛位置等待更新，暫停顯示分鐘數。: Waiting for a new position; minute estimates are paused.
這輛車已通過此站。: This bus has passed the stop.
部分路線資料暫用快取或未取得: Some route data is cached or unavailable
官方時間為路線下一班，未指定車牌。: Official times are for the route’s next bus, not this plate.
臺北市公共運輸處公開資料，每 5 秒檢查定位。個別公車回報時間以車輛資訊為準。: Taipei’s public bus data is checked every 5 seconds while active. Individual reporting times vary.
上車前核對方向與走法: Check direction and variant before boarding
前車已過站 · 等待後續車輛: Earlier buses have passed · waiting for the next
前車已過站 · 下一班尚未回報位置: Earlier bus passed · next bus not reporting its position yet
此方向暫無車輛回報: No bus positions in this direction
往此站的車輛位置待確認: Buses approaching this stop are unconfirmed
依目前路線車流: Based on current traffic on this route
總時間包含步行、可搭班次的候車及車程。官方下一班若早於你走到站牌，會改估後續班次: The total includes walking, waiting for a bus you can catch and the ride. If the official next bus arrives before you reach the stop, later buses are considered. Ride and scheduled times can change with traffic.
可搭後續班次 ·: A later bus can be caught ·
依官方分時段車程: Based on official time-of-day ride data
站間車程使用交通部 TDX 公布的分時段資料；來源不足時仍標示估計。: Stop-to-stop travel times use time-of-day data published by TDX. Missing data is shown as an estimate.
搜尋別名、文字、外觀、既有搭車設定與共用車程資料會從 GitHub 下載。這個請: Search aliases, text, appearance, trip settings and shared travel-time data download from GitHub. These requests contain no location or search text; GitHub receives standard connection information.
站間車程來自交通部運輸資料流通服務平臺（TDX）；來源不足時仍標示估計。: Stop-to-stop travel times come from the MOTC Transport Data eXchange (TDX). Missing data is shown as an estimate.
